create_relation_extractor: create a relation extraction model using AllenNLP with configurable encoder and embedding dimensions
build_relation_scorer: build a multi-class relation scorer that computes pairwise token scores over contextualized text embeddings
test_relation_extraction: test the relation extraction forward pass with gold labels and compute BCE loss
decode_predictions: decode predicted relation scores into human-readable ARG1/ARG2 token labels per sentence
get_relation_metrics: get precision, recall, and F1 metrics for the relation extraction predictions
